title: The Vanishing Place — Fortress Reactive State
summary: A small jungle fortress. Eight interior hostiles in fixed posts (two corridor pairs near the cells, Vischera + 2-soldier escort in the Med Bay, two mercs in the Comms Center), plus Admiral Varth in his cell. Outside: a four-Stormtrooper squad at the SW staging yard. Vazus Mandrake is an INDEPENDENT western actor — he approaches the SW yard on his own and commits the moment the alarm goes up or the generator drops, drawing Stormtrooper fire away from the PCs. Escalation past ORANGE is a one-way ratchet; Inquisitor Draco lands in 4 rounds once the fortress goes RED.

adv1-p2-s5.note: Crew just dropped through the inner floor grate of the drainage sluice. Mandrake parted from them at the outer grate and is circling around to the SW exterior on his own. No one inside knows the PCs are here.

adv1-p2-s6.note: Unless P2-S5 escalated the fortress, the generator room is still a routine post. Carry forward whatever tier P2-S5 ended on.

adv1-p2-s7.note: Generator tampering (however it went) costs stealth. Even a perfect sabotage leaves a dead generator — patrols notice. Start YELLOW minimum; ORANGE if the sabotage was loud or partial; RED if Varth is walking free already.

adv1-p2-s8.note: Draco is landing. The fortress is RED by definition. Reinforcement clock is already ticking.

tiers.label: UNAWARE
tiers.oneLiner: Routine ops. Nobody knows you're here.
tiers.summary: Posts are bored. Card games in the Detention Guard Post. The two soldiers in the corridor outside Varth's cell talk quietly. Vischera works at her bench in the Med Bay — mid-procedure on a Klosari subject, her two escort soldiers helmets-off and bored at the door. The Comms mercs half-watch a holo-feed of the empty SW yard. The Stormtrooper squad watches the treeline but not the building. This is your window.
tiers.patrolTempo: No interior patrols. Posts are static — bored people in fixed chairs.

tiers.label: SUSPICIOUS
tiers.summary: A missing comm check, a strange sound, a guard who didn't answer. Patrols now move in twos, weapons drawn but not shouldered. Nobody is locked down yet. The crew still has stealth on the table — but the windows are narrowing.
tiers.patrolTempo: Patrols sweep every 2 rounds. Guards stand rather than sit. Turbolift held at Level 1.

tiers.label: ALARM / LOCKDOWN
tiers.summary: The alarm panel has been tripped (or something louder). Klaxons cycle on Level 1. Mag-locks slam. The corridor pairs lock down their posts and shoot through their fence walls. The Comms mercs patch a distress signal upstream toward Draco. Outside, Mandrake opens fire on the SW Stormtrooper squad and pins them in the yard. Turrets track all exterior targets (unless the sabotage cascade has dropped them).
tiers.patrolTempo: Posts are mag-locked, fighting from cover. No movement on Level 1 except convergence to Central Hall. Reinforcement clock engaged — see schedule.

tiers.label: OPEN WAR / DRACO INBOUND
tiers.oneLiner: Inquisitor on the pad in 4 rounds. Fortress fights to the last.
tiers.summary: The fortress has committed. A distress call has punched through to Draco's shuttle (already in-system). Every NPC who can fight is fighting. Captain Vischera does NOT arm herself — the Med Bay is mag-locked from inside, escorts shoot if breached, and she begins a wipe of her cure-research drives at her terminal. The Lambda's engines whine up on the rooftop. The Draco clock is engaged — 4 rounds until Shadow Troopers boot onto the roof.
tiers.patrolTempo: Full combat. No routine. Reinforcement clock continues — see schedule. Round 4: Draco arrives.

ratchet.description: Escalation is a one-way ratchet past ORANGE. Stealth crews have narrow de-escalation windows at GREEN and YELLOW. ORANGE is terminal — the klaxon rang and too many people heard it. RED is auto-progression from ORANGE if nothing is resolved in 4 rounds.

paths.window: Must neutralize the trigger within 1 round (hide body, silence witness, fake the comm check, restore the missed patrol ping). Otherwise YELLOW holds.

Within the SAME round the alarm is tripped: sever the alarm line at Central Hall (Hard Mechanics), OR fake an all-clear over Comms (Hard Slice + Deception), OR kill every witness before they transmit. After the round ends, ORANGE holds.

paths.note: The klaxon rang. Too many people heard it. No going back.

paths.auto: Auto-escalates on Round 4 of ORANGE if the alarm isn't cut at Central Hall by then.
paths.note: RED is also triggered immediately by: a Varth sighting in any non-cell zone, any blaster fire in the Command Area, or the Lambda on the rooftop taking damage.
Draco is coming. There is no de-escalation.

escalationTriggers.label: Body discovered
escalationTriggers.readAloud: A shout down the corridor — sharp, sudden, cut short. Then a klaxon picks up the beat. Red light strobes across the basalt. The fortress knows.
escalationTriggers.counter: Hide the body (Hard Stealth/Athletics, 1 round) BEFORE another NPC enters the zone. At GREEN, this rolls back. At YELLOW, this holds the tier.

escalationTriggers.label: Blaster fire indoors
escalationTriggers.readAloud: Blaster-bolt echo ricochets through stone that wasn't built to hold it. Somewhere you can't see, a voice barks orders. Boots slap flagstone. Running toward you.
escalationTriggers.counter: None. Energy weapon discharge inside is a hard escalate. (Vibroblades, stun batons, unarmed takedowns do NOT trigger this.)

escalationTriggers.label: Missed patrol comm check
escalationTriggers.readAloud: Over a mercenary shoulder you can hear it: a comlink hissing a question that isn't being answered. The second hiss. The third. Someone is now walking toward the silence.
escalationTriggers.counter: Fake the ping from the missing patrol's comlink (Hard Slice, Disguise voice mod) within 1 round. Holds GREEN.

escalationTriggers.label: Alarm panel pulled
escalationTriggers.readAloud: The klaxon starts low, winds up, hits its note. Every mag-lock on Level 1 slams home in sequence — crack, crack, crack, down the corridor.
escalationTriggers.counter: Sever the alarm line at Central Hall (Hard Mechanics) WITHIN the same round. Cuts the klaxon and rolls back to YELLOW. If the GM rules that the signal already reached Comms Center, this fails.

escalationTriggers.label: Generator being tampered (detected)
escalationTriggers.readAloud: Footsteps in the corridor — one of the patrol pair from S of the generator has wandered N to bum a powerpack from Storage and is about to walk straight into whatever the PCs are doing to the housing.
escalationTriggers.counter: Silence the wandering merc before he back-pedals to comm. Hard Stealth grab or a one-round takedown. If he gets a comm out, the Comms Center hears it and ORANGE fires.

escalationTriggers.label: Generator goes dark (sabotage complete)
escalationTriggers.readAloud: The generator's hum — that low note you've been feeling in your teeth — stops. Work-lights flicker and die. For one held breath the whole fortress is silent. Then backup sirens kick in, the laser fences die, and somewhere south of you, prisoners start shouting. Outside the W wall, blaster-fire opens up — that's Mandrake.
escalationTriggers.counter: None. The entire fortress feels the lights go out. This is inherent to the sabotage payoff — see `sabotageCascade` for the compensations.

escalationTriggers.label: Varth sighted outside his cell
escalationTriggers.readAloud: A guard rounds the corner, sees him, freezes. Varth is already walking. The guard's blaster comes up. Over the fortress comms: the Admiral is loose. Repeat. The Admiral is loose.
escalationTriggers.counter: None. Varth escaping is the fortress's worst-case alert. It goes straight to RED.

escalationTriggers.label: Blaster fire on Level 2 (Command)
escalationTriggers.readAloud: The holo-table sputters and dies. A Skarn officer is screaming into a headset. On the rooftop, the Lambda's engines start to whine.

escalationTriggers.label: Sluice sensor / loud noise (GM discretion)
escalationTriggers.readAloud: A muted ping from somewhere in the comm gear — barely a blip. Not enough to wake the fortress. Not yet.
escalationTriggers.counter: Not a forced escalation. GM's option: at any time after a sluice sensor trip OR loud noise that would carry through the pipe, send 1–2 Stormtroopers in from the SW yard to investigate. If they find anything, run `body_found` or `blaster_fire_indoors` from there. This exists to convert player risk into pressure when the GM wants tension.

deEscalationTriggers.label: Hide body / sanitize scene
deEscalationTriggers.check: Hard Stealth OR Athletics — must be resolved in 1 round, before any other NPC enters the zone.
deEscalationTriggers.readAloud: You drag the body behind the generator housing, kick a ration pack over the blood smear. Footsteps approach and pass and continue on. For now, the silence holds.

deEscalationTriggers.label: Silence the lone witness
deEscalationTriggers.check: Takedown before the NPC transmits (any action that reduces them to 0 VIT in a single round, or a Hard Stealth grab).
deEscalationTriggers.readAloud: Their hand was on the comlink. Your hand closes over theirs. The comlink hits the floor and slides under a supply crate. They slump.

deEscalationTriggers.label: Sever the alarm line at Central Hall
deEscalationTriggers.check: Hard Mechanics (Security Kit steps it down). Must happen in the SAME round the alarm was raised. If the signal reached Comms Center, the GM rules this fails.
deEscalationTriggers.readAloud: The klaxon chokes mid-cycle. Red light still pools in the corridor, but the sound dies. Somewhere above you, a voice is asking why the feed went quiet.

deEscalationTriggers.label: Fake an all-clear over Comms
deEscalationTriggers.check: Hard Slice (to spoof the channel) + Hard Deception (for the voice). Must happen in the SAME round the alarm was raised. Requires access to Comms Center.
deEscalationTriggers.readAloud: Your voice comes out Imperial-clipped, passable. 'All clear. Junior tripped a panel. Stand down, stand down.' A pause. Then: 'Acknowledged. Stand down.' The klaxon cuts out.

reinforcementClock.description: Rounds counted from the moment the fortress went ORANGE.

schedule.event: Mandrake opens fire on the SW Stormtrooper squad from the treeline. Both corridor pairs (Detention Guard Post + Varth's Cell approach) mag-lock in place and shoot through their respective fence walls. Comms mercs begin patching a distress signal upstream.
Comms Center distress signal connects to Draco's Lambda. Vischera and her 2 escort soldiers mag-lock the Med Bay from inside.
Stormtrooper squad either pushes through Mandrake's fire (if Mandrake is down) and reaches the W doors, OR is still pinned in the SW yard. Command Area pilots board the Lambda.
If the alarm is still live at Central Hall: AUTO-ESCALATE to RED. Draco's Lambda is on final approach.

dracoClock.description: Once RED: Draco's shuttle is 4 rounds out. At the top of Round 4 (counting from RED), Shadow Troopers boot onto the rooftop and Inquisitor Draco walks off the ramp. This is the P2-S8 scene in motion.

countdown.event: Lambda signature on long-range sensors. Command-Area pilots clear the rooftop pad and re-park the Skarn Lambda to make room.
Lambda in visual range. Engine whine audible from anywhere on Level 2.
Final approach. Lambda banks into the clearing. Landing lights flood the rooftop.
TOUCHDOWN. Ramp drops. Shadow Troopers deploy. Draco walks off. Switch to P2-S8 full stat blocks.

zones.label: Drainage Sluice
zones.description: Knee-deep runoff tunnel on the NW exterior face. The PC entry path. Three obstacles in sequence: outer grate (forced or sliced open) → embedded motion/IR sensors halfway through (Assess to spot, Tech to disable, Stealth — esp. underwater — to bypass) → inner floor grate emerging into the interior corridor. Sound carries both ways through the pipe.

GREEN.note: Nobody watches the sluice from inside. It reads as a drainage pipe on every blueprint Skarn's people have. The sensors are passive — they only matter if the PCs trip them.

YELLOW.note: Still off the patrol list. If the PCs tripped a sensor on the way in, the GM may (at their discretion) start trickling 1–2 Stormtroopers in from the SW yard to investigate.

ORANGE.note: A merc jams a supply crate into the interior grate. Crew inside cannot retreat this way without a Hard Athletics to shove it clear.

RED.note: Two mercs posted at the interior grate with blasters. Also the exterior mouth is being watched by a rooftop spotter.

zones.label: Medical Bay
zones.description: Vischera's enclosed lab on the W side. She works at the bench with two Skarn soldiers posted inside as escort/security. Default scene state is mid-procedure on a Klosari villager strapped to the surgical table — the room's quiet horror. See enc-s8-medbay for the full moral-quandary scene.

GREEN.note: Vischera at her bench, back to the door, mid-procedure on a restrained Klosari subject, dictating clinical notes into a recorder. Two soldiers near the door — one seated on a crate, one leaning against the wall, helmets off, bored. This is the default. The horror is mundane and routine.

YELLOW.note: Soldiers stand straight, blasters in hand. Vischera continues working but glances at the door every ~30s. The subject on the table is still there.

ORANGE.note: Soldiers mag-lock the bay from inside and take cover behind the surgical table. Vischera moves to her terminal and begins prepping a data-wipe of her cure-research drives (Hard Tech check from outside to interrupt; otherwise drives are scrubbed in 2 rounds). She does not arm herself.

RED.note: If breached, soldiers fight. Vischera does not arm herself, does not run, surrenders the moment shooting stops. Her behavior in the moral-quandary beat is unchanged by tier — she is calm, clinical, unrepentant, and will trade her data and intel for safe passage. See enc-s8-medbay for the six resolution paths.

zones.label: Storage
zones.description: Weapon crates, ration kits, det cord. Enclosed, NW.

GREEN.note: Door usually open. Empty unless someone happens to be restocking.

ORANGE.note: Mercs from the corridor pairs rotate through here for spare powerpacks during the convergence.

RED.note: Looted hard — proton grenades and heavy ordnance pulled.

zones.label: Comms Center
zones.description: Clone-Wars-era comm relay banks in an enclosed room, N-center of Level 1. Two Skarn mercs work the consoles full-time.

GREEN.note: Two mercs at the consoles. One scrolling a transmission log, one half-watching a holo-feed of the SW yard. Door open.

YELLOW.note: Door closed. Both on the horn trying to raise whoever went quiet. Blasters within reach.

ORANGE.note: Both heads-down. One is patching a distress signal upstream to Draco's Lambda — 2 rounds to connect.

RED.note: Distress signal went through. Mercs now coordinating Draco's landing approach.

zones.label: Central Hall
zones.description: Open assembly floor on Level 1. The generator housing sits in the middle of the room as physical cover. Sightlines run S through the pens to the corridor outside Varth's Cell.

GREEN.note: Empty most of the time. Occasionally a merc cuts through on errand traffic — never long enough to be a guaranteed encounter. The generator hums on its own; nobody's posted on it.

YELLOW.note: Errand traffic doubles. Mercs from the Comms Center and Med Bay foot-pass through more often, blasters in hand instead of holstered.

ORANGE.note: Convergence point. Both corridor pairs (north + south) fall back here at end of Round 1. Klaxons active. Mag-locks on enclosed rooms slammed.

RED.note: Open kill zone. Anyone caught in the middle takes multi-target fire from every interior NPC still alive.

zones.label: Turbolift & Stairs
zones.description: Shaft between Level 1 and Level 2. Stairs run alongside.

GREEN.note: Car parked at Level 1. Crew can use it freely if they can fake Imperial creds. Stairs alongside are unwatched.

YELLOW.note: Car held at Level 1 'by order.' No one posted, but the comms mercs will hear if it cycles.

ORANGE.note: Car held. Stairs contested if PCs push for Level 2 — Skarn officers up there will fire down the shaft.

RED.note: If the PCs have breached Level 2, Draco's Shadow Troopers come down this way at Round 4+.

zones.label: Detention Guard Post
zones.description: Enclosed guard room on the corridor S of the generator and N of the prisoner pens. Two Skarn soldiers posted here have line-of-sight S through the E fence wall of the pens.

GREEN.note: Two soldiers, blasters propped against the wall. One playing solitaire on a datapad, one watching the pens through the E fence with the disinterest of a long shift.

YELLOW.note: Both standing, blasters in hand. Watching the pens AND the corridor mouth N toward the generator. Comm-checks every 30 seconds.

ORANGE.note: Mag-lock the post from inside. Shoot through the E fence at any prisoner movement. Will not exit — their orders are to hold this corridor.

RED.note: Same posture, locked in, firing. If Varth has been sighted in motion they're already dead or fled S.

zones.label: Varth's Cell
zones.description: Solo cell at the SE end of the detention block — walled, mag-locked, separate from the Pens. A short corridor runs from the pens to the cell door; two Skarn soldiers stand in that corridor as Varth's last line of containment.

GREEN.note: Cell mag-locked. Two soldiers in the corridor outside, leaning on the wall, talking quietly. Varth sits on his cot watching the door with the patience of someone who's been expecting visitors.

YELLOW.note: Same — soldiers now standing upright, blasters in hand. Varth has noticed the tempo change and is standing near his door.

ORANGE.note: Soldiers brace at the corridor mouth, weapons up. Mag-lock cycles to a security override (Hard Mechanics to bypass). If the generator is dead, the mag-lock is open and Varth is trying to walk out past them.

RED.note: Soldiers fighting in place. If the generator is dead, Varth is in motion and they are between him and the corridor — and they know it.

zones.label: Prisoner Pens (×3)
zones.description: Three laser-fence pens holding Mandrake's people. S of generator. Pen 3 (easternmost) has an east fence directly visible to the Detention Guard Post.

GREEN.note: Laser fences hum. ~12 prisoners total huddled inside. No guards posted at the pens — the fences do the work.

YELLOW.note: Detention Guard Post now pays attention to the pens. Any visible movement toward a fence draws a blaster bolt through Pen 3's east wall.

ORANGE.note: Same, more aggressive. Patrols pass the pens without slowing.

RED.note: If the laser fences are DOWN (sabotage cascade): prisoners stream out the W side toward the firefight Mandrake is running in the SW yard. If the fences are UP: prisoners screaming, fortress ignoring them.

zones.label: Exterior West (Staging Area)
zones.description: Cleared ground outside the SW wall. Four Stormtroopers at parade rest, plus a sergeant. Vazus Mandrake stalks this approach from the treeline once the fortress goes loud — he is the PCs' western pressure release.

GREEN.note: Squad watching the treeline, not the building. Mandrake is somewhere in the canopy, not yet committed.

YELLOW.note: Squad facing half toward the treeline, half toward the W doors. Sergeant on comm. Mandrake holds position.

ORANGE.note: Squad moves to breach the W doors — but Mandrake opens fire from the treeline at the start of Round 1, pinning them in the yard. The Stormtroopers do NOT make it to Central Hall while Mandrake is alive and shooting.

RED.note: Open firefight in the yard between Mandrake and the surviving Stormtroopers. The W doors are effectively a Mandrake-held checkpoint — the PCs can exit this way if they can reach it.

zones.label: Gun Turrets (W + E)
zones.description: Automated turrets, generator-powered. Cover the exterior approaches.

GREEN.note: Slow track, no lock-on. A stealthy approach from the S ridge avoids them entirely.

YELLOW.note: Faster sweep, tighter arc. Any thermal signature from the treeline flags.

ORANGE.note: Turrets fire on any unauthorized target in the open. Maya's approach gets chewed up unless they're disabled.

RED.note: Same — these are automated. They only go dark when the generator does.

zones.label: Command Area (Level 2)
zones.description: Upper sanctum. Holotable, tactical displays. Skarn officers + Imperial advance team.

GREEN.note: Skarn officers around the holotable. Two pilots and a comms specialist. Watching the displays, not the turbolift door.

YELLOW.note: Officers on comm trying to raise the patrol that went dark. One pilot drifts toward the rooftop ramp.

ORANGE.note: Officers coordinating the lockdown. Pilots board the Lambda. Stairs and turbolift held against PC ascent.

RED.note: Officers patch Draco's approach and Lambda departure. Will surrender if breached cleanly — they're not paid to die for Skarn.

zones.label: Rooftop Landing Pad (Level 2)
zones.description: Lambda-class shuttle parked on the open-air pad. The shuttle is cold and unmanned in routine ops; pilots are inside Level 2 Command. The pad becomes the focus of the fortress in RED — Draco's shuttle lands here.

GREEN.note: Pad empty. Lambda cold. The horizon is unwatched from up here — Skarn never expected an attack from above.

YELLOW.note: A pilot from Command Area moves to the Lambda's ramp, just in case. Otherwise quiet.

ORANGE.note: Lambda spinning up. Pilot in the cockpit. Pad otherwise empty.

RED.note: Lambda hot. Pad is the LZ for Draco — at Round 4 of RED his shuttle lands alongside.

npcGroups.label: Skarn Soldiers — Detention Guard Post (N pair)
npcGroups.composition: 2 Skarn Mercenaries (Standard). Posted in the enclosed Detention Guard Post on the corridor S of the generator and N of the prisoner pens. Reuse the P2-S5 mercenary threatBuild.

byTier.GREEN: Sitting. Blasters propped. One on a datapad, one half-watching the pens through the E fence wall.
byTier.YELLOW: Standing, blasters in hand. Watching both N (toward the generator) and S (through the fence into the pens). Comm-check every 30s.
byTier.ORANGE: Mag-lock the post from inside. Fire through the E fence at any movement in the pens. Do NOT exit — their job is holding this corridor.
byTier.RED: Same posture, fighting from inside. Already dead or fled S if Varth has been sighted in motion.

npcGroups.label: Skarn Soldiers — Varth's Cell Corridor (S pair)
npcGroups.composition: 2 Skarn Mercenaries (Standard). Posted in the short corridor outside Varth's Cell door, between the Pens and the cell. Reuse the P2-S5 mercenary threatBuild.

byTier.GREEN: Leaning on the wall, talking quietly. Blasters slung. The mag-locked cell behind them is what they're paid to be near, not stare at.
byTier.YELLOW: Standing upright. Blasters in hand. Eyes on the corridor mouth N toward the pens.
byTier.ORANGE: Brace at the corridor mouth, weapons up. If the mag-lock blows because the generator is dead, they are the last barrier between Varth and the door.
byTier.RED: Fighting in place. They know if Varth gets past them, the mission is lost.

npcGroups.label: Captain Vischera + Med Bay Escort
npcGroups.composition: Captain Vischera (P2-S5 threatBuild — non-combatant, surrenders calmly when escorts fall, anchors the moral-quandary scene at enc-s8-medbay) + 2 Skarn Mercenaries (Standard) posted as escort/security inside the Med Bay. The escorts are alive because of Vischera's cure work and protect her with full knowledge of what she does to the Klosari villagers Skarn supplies her with.

byTier.GREEN: Vischera at her bench, back to the door, mid-procedure on a restrained Klosari subject, dictating clinical notes. Both soldiers near the door — helmets off, bored, not watching her, not watching it.
byTier.YELLOW: Soldiers stand and ready blasters. Vischera continues working but glances at the door, hand near a scalpel.
byTier.ORANGE: Soldiers mag-lock the bay and take cover behind the surgical table. Vischera moves to her terminal and begins a data-wipe of her cure-research drives (Hard Tech from outside to interrupt; otherwise scrubbed in 2 rounds). She does not arm herself.
byTier.RED: Soldiers fight if breached. Vischera does not arm herself, does not run, surrenders the moment shooting stops. See enc-s8-medbay for the moral-quandary scene.

npcGroups.label: Skarn Comms Mercs
npcGroups.composition: 2 Skarn Mercenaries (Standard) at the Communications Center consoles. Reuse the P2-S5 mercenary threatBuild.

byTier.GREEN: Bored. One scrolling a transmission log, one half-watching a holo-feed of the SW yard. Door open.
byTier.YELLOW: Door closed. Both on the horn trying to raise whoever went quiet. Blasters within reach but not in hand.
byTier.ORANGE: Heads-down. One patches a distress signal upstream toward Draco's Lambda — 2 rounds to connect.
byTier.RED: Distress signal sent. Coordinating Draco's landing approach. Fight only if breached.

npcGroups.label: Stormtrooper Squad — SW Yard
npcGroups.composition: 4 Stormtroopers + 1 Sergeant at the SW Exterior Staging Area. Reuse P1-S5 Stormtrooper threatBuild.

byTier.GREEN: Parade rest near supply crates. Watching the treeline — but not closely. The Sergeant is bored.
byTier.YELLOW: Sergeant on comm. Squad moves to cover positions along the W wall, half facing in, half facing out.
byTier.ORANGE: Squad attempts to breach the W doors — but Mandrake opens fire from the treeline at start of Round 1 and pins them in the yard. They do NOT reach Central Hall while Mandrake is active.
byTier.RED: Open firefight with Mandrake in the yard. The W doors become a contested checkpoint.

npcGroups.label: Vazus Mandrake (Western Approach)
npcGroups.composition: Vazus Mandrake — Separatist Holdout Commando, independent ally. He is NOT in the building. He circled W after parting from the PCs at the sluice mouth and shadows the Stormtrooper squad from the treeline. His combat statline is in his character sheet (ranged commando — sniper rifle + det charges).

byTier.GREEN: In the treeline NW of the SW yard. Watching the squad. Holding fire — every minute the PCs are quiet is a minute he doesn't have to commit.
byTier.YELLOW: Same — holds position. The PCs still have stealth on the table; Mandrake won't burn his concealment.
byTier.ORANGE: COMMITS. Opens fire on the Stormtrooper squad from the treeline at start of Round 1. His job is to keep that squad OUT of the building so the PCs aren't fighting on two fronts.
byTier.RED: Pushing into the SW yard. If the laser fences have dropped, he breaks for the W doors to extract the freed prisoners. He will not chase deeper into the fortress — his fight is the W approach.

npcGroups.label: Skarn Command Officers + Lambda Pilots (Level 2)
npcGroups.composition: Skarn officers around the holotable + 2 Lambda pilots + 1 comms specialist on Level 2. See P2-S8 threatBuild for officer statline.

byTier.GREEN: Around the holotable. Watching displays. Not watching the turbolift door.
byTier.YELLOW: On comm trying to raise the patrol that went dark. One pilot drifts toward the rooftop ramp.
byTier.ORANGE: Coordinate the lockdown. Pilots board the Lambda. Stairs and turbolift held against PC ascent.
byTier.RED: Patch Draco's approach. Will surrender if breached cleanly — they are not paid to die for Skarn.

npcGroups.label: Admiral Gilder Varth
npcGroups.composition: Prisoner. Non-hostile to the crew but imperious. See P2-S7 threatBuild.

byTier.GREEN: Sits on his cot. Hands folded. Patient. Assumes this will resolve itself.
byTier.YELLOW: Standing near his door. Has already guessed something is happening.
byTier.ORANGE: Demands the crew open his cell NOW. Treats the rescue like a hired service. If the generator is dead his mag-lock is open and he is trying to push out past the S corridor pair.
byTier.RED: Moving on his own if he can. Will commandeer a blaster if offered. Will not risk HIS life for a pen full of locals.

sabotageCascade.description: Collapses the prior ad-hoc flags from P2-S6 into the fortress state. When the Generator dies, FOUR things happen simultaneously (cascade payoff), but the sabotage itself is visible/audible across the fortress — sabotage ALWAYS escalates to ORANGE minimum.

full_sabotage.label: Full sabotage (Legendary or Masterful on the sabotage check)
full_sabotage.readAloud: The generator dies with a wet electrical cough. Every work-light on Level 1 drops dark, then flickers back on in dim emergency amber. South of you, the laser fences die. A moment of silence — and then the mag-locks on Level 1 all pop open at once, a sharp percussive CRACK-CRACK-CRACK down every corridor. Prisoners start shouting. Somewhere a klaxon is trying to rally a fortress that suddenly has no teeth.

partial_sabotage.label: Partial sabotage (Fleeting success — one or two cascade effects fire, others don't)
partial_sabotage.readAloud: The generator coughs, shudders, and keeps running — worse than before, but running. SOME things die; others hold. (GM picks which 2 of the 4 cascade effects fire. Priority suggestion: fences drop, mag-locks open. Turrets and sensors keep watching.)

failed_sabotage.label: Failed sabotage (crew made the check but triggered detection, OR failed the check)
failed_sabotage.readAloud: The generator hums on, untouched. A red diagnostic light winks to life on the housing. Comms picks up the ping immediately — both corridor pairs go to weapons-up, and outside Mandrake's blasterfire opens up early. The fortress knows.
